purpose: Reusable multi-tile visual assemblies from project-owned and approved licensed sources with stable identity, collision, interaction, undo, save, editor preview, and runtime rendering.

footprintModel.visual: rectangular tile footprint derived from visualFootprint and origin
footprintModel.collision: rectangular movement-blocking footprint derived from collisionFootprint
footprintModel.interaction: defaults to collision footprint and remains separately persisted
placementRules: all active footprints stay inside scene bounds
blocking collision stays on walkable terrain

editorWorkflow: Open Scene Editor and Assets dock
Choose Stamps or search by label, category, stable ID, or footprint
Select a thumbnail to activate Objects layer and Place tool
Move pointer over canvas to preview ghost, anchor, and valid/invalid footprint
Click to place as one typed undo transaction
Select any visual tile or outliner row to bind stable selection and inspector
Drag selection or use clipboard duplicate/paste to move/copy with collision validation
For expandable LPC ponds, use Inspector width/height controls to repeat authored center and edge cells without stretching pixels
Delete or erase and use Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y for typed undo/redo
Use Save All or Ctrl+S to persist stamp records in the shared world document

runtime.renderer: loads all unique registry atlas sheets with nearest filtering
runtime.sort: stamp collision foot sorts with objects, customers, and player
runtime.fallback: unresolved assets render an explicit bounded placeholder

definitionEditing: Reusable stamp rect, origin, source roles, and minimum footprints are edited through approved manifest/Asset Intake workflows. Expandable placed instances may resize width and height; freeform occupied-cell editing remains a later pass.
licensePolicy: Only ElizaWy/LPC source-derived stamp manifests are active. Every promoted family must retain source-lock, author, source, license, and coordinate metadata; mixed, prototype, placeholder, or unresolved uploads remain excluded.
